newsitem.title: UK: CSFB names Mulford as chairman, Europe.
newsitem.headline: CSFB names Mulford as chairman, Europe.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB), the investment banking arm of Credit Suisse , said on Wednesday it had appointed Dr David Mulford as chairman, Europe, of the restructured CSFB.
In a statement CSFB said Mulford would also become vice chairman of CSFB and join its executive board.
Mulford, a former policy official in the U.S. Treasury, joined CSFB in 1992 and has been heavily involved in Latin American and European emerging capital markets.
He will chair CSFB's Latin American executive committee, the bank added.
Commenting on his own appointment, Mulford said, "Europe, Russia and the emerging economies of central Europe are key to our long term success in world finance".
